name: Brown County, NE
findings: Brown County has 23 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Brown County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Brown County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 70% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
